card.text: One of the youngest fully formed planets imaged, about 10 Jupiter masses, on a Solar System scale.

sources.label: Stolker et al. 2025
sources.quote: HD 135344 Ab is one of the youngest directly imaged planets that has fully formed

introduction.text: HD 135344 Ab orbits 15 to 20 au from its star, found by SPHERE and confirmed by GRAVITY. Its colors match those of a mid-L type object.

sources.label: Stolker et al. 2025
sources.quote: The semi-major axis of the planetary orbit is approximately 15-20 au

sources.label: Stolker et al. 2025
sources.quote: the photometry is consistent with that of a mid L-type object

infrared.title: Infrared brightness
infrared.summary: False color from flux densities in three infrared bands, longest wavelength red.
